test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Anurag has given me this book to read.

options.text: This book has given me Anurag to read.
I have been given this book by Anurag to read.
This book has been given by me to Anurag to read.
I have given this book to Anurag to read.

solution:
The correct answer is: **I have been given this book by Anurag to read.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and in the Present Perfect tense and we need to change it to the passive form.
 
• The Present Perfect in the active voice has the following form: Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object__
 
• The Present Perfect in the passive voice has the following form: __Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)__
 
• 
 __
 
• Passive: *Rahul has challenged her.*
 
• Active: *She has been challenged by Rahul.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the Subject into the object.
 
• In the case of the Present Perfect tense, '**been**' should be used after have/has.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Active Voice:__ *I have been given this book by Anurag to read.*
